Custom 'Fusion 360 Gallery Dataset License' (rev 11/2021): clause 1 restricts use to non-commercial research; clause 2 forbids redistributing the Dataset in its entirety; clause 3 allows a restricted 'Modified Set' only under an at-least-as-restrictive non-commercial chain; clause 4 forbids re-associating models with creators.
Best public source for CAD operation-sequence statistics (extrude/fillet/chamfer distribution) - i.e. the 'feature order' technique - which can be cited without ingesting payload.

title: DeepCAD (CAD construction sequences, cad_json/cad_vec)

parameters.name: annotation_types
parameters.description: command/parameter construction sequences + vectorised cad_vec

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: per-sequence native CAD units

parameters.name: file_format
parameters.description: json (cad_json) + vectorised arrays (cad_vec)

notes:
VERDICT: reference-only.
Repo LICENSE is MIT, but the README states cad_json contains files 'we parsed from Onshape' - the same creator-owned lineage as ABC. No separate data agreement located. So MIT covers their parser output as published, not the underlying designs' copyright.
Freely reusable part is the METHOD: how a CAD construction sequence is serialised into a command/parameter vector (an idea, and the code is MIT). Do not ingest the sequences.

parameters.name: object_count
parameters.description: ~800k+ objects in the aggregate (see project page)

parameters.name: annotation_types
parameters.description: captions, tags, per-object licence + provenance metadata

parameters.name: per_object_license
parameters.description: constituent objects carry their own CC licences (Sketchfab lineage)

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: heterogeneous; normalised on load

notes:
VERDICT: reference-only; per-object licence check required before any asset use.
The aggregate is tagged ODC-By-1.0 on HuggingFace, which is attribution-only and would permit commercial use OF THE DATABASE RIGHTS - but it cannot relicense a CC-BY-NC or all-rights-reserved object inside the collection.
Its real value is as the canonical example of 'heterogeneous per-object licences -> you need a licence field per row', which is exactly the rule this harvest applied to Printables.
Evidence: HuggingFace API metadata (license tag: odc-by); see report section 2.6
